proposedArchitecture.recommendedApproach: Signed event inbox plus atomic issue reservation
flow: POST /api/webhooks/fourthwall reads raw bytes before JSON parsing
Reject missing or invalid Fourthwall HMAC before any database write
Accept only ORDER_PLACED for V1-compatible payloads and the configured shop
Insert webhook event id into an idempotency ledger with a uniqueness constraint
Recover only opaque io_quote_id from order/cart metadata; never require customer identity or quiz answers
Resolve the quote and locked physical selection server-side
Atomically create one private RESERVED issue with a cryptographically random nonsequential permanent Issue ID
Use a database uniqueness constraint plus bounded collision retry; issued/void/cancelled IDs are never reusable
Return 200 for an already-processed duplicate event without creating a second issue
Keep public verification out of this first implementation slice until private reservation is durable
testGates: duplicate event id produces exactly one RESERVED issue
unknown quote id produces no issue and an observable recoverable processing failure
random Issue ID collision retries without reusing any existing ID
payload cannot choose variant/product/price independently of the server quote
testMode events never create production RESERVED issues
